description: Curated value-investing principle, historical fact or attributed paraphrase from Oxford Ledge's corpus (~2,000 entries about Buffett, Graham, Munger, Klarman and others). THE WORDING IS NOT VERIFIED against the primary source: none is a verbatim quotation unless `verbatim` is true -- so never present the text as the author's exact words, and credit it with the `attribution` line. THE SHAPE DEPENDS ON THE ARGUMENTS: a `query` returns {facts, count, total_facts} (facts capped at 10); a bare `category` or no arguments returns {fact, total_facts} (one random pick). Pedagogical content only -- never a market signal. Cached 24h per argument set.

category.description: Optional category filter, one of the listed values (case-insensitive); omit for a random pick. Any other value is refused (INVALID_PARAMS) naming the values.

query.description: Optional search query to find facts by keyword (e.g. 'moat', 'fear')

name: get_value_investing_fact
title: Value Investing Facts
